company.name: Zelo
company.shortDescription: Zelo is a digital financing platform that offers invoice financing and revenue-based financing solutions for businesses.
company.description: Zelo offers a digital financing platform that provides quick access to capital for businesses through invoice finance and revenue finance. It enables companies to receive funds against approved invoices, often within 24 hours, and offers flexible repayment options based on their revenue. The platform aims to accelerate business growth by providing liquidity and is regulated by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Undisclosed round raised $715,000,000, or 99.68% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,721,893 to $2,393,877,192, a 274.47x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 75 (-10 over 90 days) and market heat at 47 (-16).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
